design_decisions.A: Store eye-level composition: wide open shop portals, darker frames, warm interiors, floor reflectance controlled, window displays with real garments and shoes. Remove repetitive v9 coffer grid.
design_decisions.B: Keep three courts and circulation; remove repetitive baffle decoration, articulate actual upper balconies/void edges and keep view axis to the existing atrium.
design_decisions.C: Different pavilion finishes and roofs/awnings, proper foliage, paving and sunlight. Any reduced deck geometry is an explicitly unapproved separate option; original v9 data stays immutable.
